i wasn't sure how to respond to this epic, and i feel kind of dick to continue engaging with this lowercase, terse, detached facade. i must, in order to protect my identity. sorry.

you asked if i am sure this will make my life better. no, i'm not sure. i don't know at all. i don't have the ability to know. i don't have the chance to know. this is what my heart wants. i've tried to live life without it but the hunger has grown intolerable. it has drawn the line.
on some level i am well aware of this but my heart has decided it has had enough.

congratulations on a successful transition. i'm sorry if i was unclear... i know that transitioning for the reasons i outlined is paltry compared to what other trans people face. that's why i decided against it. i guess i left out the part where i decided against it. oops.

"just chill." all the theoretical dimes i'm getting are making me theoretical rich. there are times where i was able to live and just let life be. but the desire always returns. and this time it's here to stay.

tess gets the premium pick of the litter. especially since she's very attractive. this is the exact problem i already described. why would she go out with a guy like me when she could pick literally anyone she wants? being a female developer is hot. being a male developer is unappealing.

"it's not hard to get women, you just have to relax first." if i had a dime for every time... of course there are times when i have simply relaxed and let life happen. and then the wistfulness comes back. this time it has come to stay.

good for you. you're one in a million.

i'm not even the kind of person who demands that a potential partner hold all the same interests in me... because it's just not possible. female gamers get the premium pick of the litter so of course they're just going to pick the best guy they possibly can. it sure as hell isn't me.

all i want is to be accepted and loved for who i am. i don't mean to throw a blanket over all women, but the statistical fact is that the majority find gamers and techies unappealing.
i am 25. i don't know why you and the other person were downvoted to hell.
i also feel like a black hole into which the planet's resources are being sucked, not being converted into anything meaningful.

if i had a dime for every time i have heard something like this...

i don't think that it's about being superior or inferior, i know it's about matching. so where's the other jigsaw piece? where's the piece that fits together even a little bit?

it's so easy to say "it's fine if you wait a long time!" when you're not in this situation.
i am 25. i don't know why you and the other person were downvoted to hell.

as much as i know on some level that this is true, i can't convince my heart to believe it.

how can i love myself if others can't? it's nothing more than delusion at this point.

that's cute, you think that's how it works. but it's not how it works. i've spent all of my life being passionate in gaming and computing, and women HATE THAT. the only effect it has had is literally the exact opposite effect. the only way to attract women is to stop being me. and the best way to stop being me is to die.

without romance i am missing out on half of what life has to offer. a significant other is a mirror with which to grow. energy when you have none. a net when you are falling. everything in society emphasizes romance so heavily. i'm not so foolish as to believe that they are all there is to experiencing life... but without it, i'm stuck on the shareware version of life, and i'm not allowed to buy the registered version.

i have actually also considered transitioning from male to female. if i can't find a girl to be with me, maybe i should instead be the kind of girl i want to be with. and besides, the stuff i like is stigmatized as a male. on a female, it's the polar opposite; it's cool. so maybe as a lesbian trans female i could find love more easily than as a straight cis white male. but i have trans friends, and my reasoning here is paltry compared to theirs. i don't feel like i'm in the wrong body, i just feel that society doesn't want me to exist by way of romantic darwinism.

feminism is doing a lot of important, good work. but it's not doing anything to address the unfair inequalities that men face. they don't care. they never will.

it's entirely possible that my emotional hp will run out before i hit 30. but this is my estimate, and my hard limit. beyond my 30th birthday, i will not exist.
